items.title: Deploy Amazon RDS for Oracle on AWS Outposts
items.summary: Learn how to deploy Amazon RDS for Oracle on AWS Outposts to run fully managed Oracle databases on premises while meeting data residency and compliance requirements. This post walks through creating a DB instance using the AWS Management Console and the AWS CLI, and covers disaster recovery options.
items.creator: Vetrivel Subramani

items.title: From instant Aurora PostgreSQL databases to production-ready in your VPC
items.summary: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL express configuration now supports VPC networking. You can move an existing cluster into your VPC with a single modify operation, keeping its data and endpoint, from the console, the AWS CLI, or an AI agent. This post shows how to move and verify a cluster, and how to let an agent do it with IAM guardrails.
items.creator: Saurabh Kothawade
